  where

      where f xs = (fst (head xs), msFromList (map snd xs))

    (same, diff) = partition (\((c1,c2),_) -> c1 == c2) pairs

    diffCor :: Maybe [(Int, MySet)]

      where f ((c1,c2), lst) = do
